Corollary
[Distinguishing singular and nonsingular points] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0180 ↗ thm:chow-iv-type-i-singular-point-sets-equal 1. ch30:30.26\group Type I Singularity Models

At every point $p$ of a closed Type I singular solution, either $\liminf _{t\nearrow \omega }(\omega -t)R(p,t)>0$, or curvature remains uniformly bounded along every sequence $(p_i,t_i)\to (p,\omega )$.
